state:
Goal `core-response-and-1-more`: eight of `Core\Response`'s ten members carry every feature proof —
`addCookie`, `bytes`, `html`, `text`, `json`, `setStatus`, `setHeader` and `redirect` — with
`about.md`, three examples with `.nvsr` requests, the attack, the bench record in
`docs/perf/members.ndjson`, and a `covers:` line in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/response.rs`'s `tests`
module. Their cards follow AGENTS.md § *Text an end user reads*. `sendFile` and `stream` owe every
proof, and their cards are not plain yet. `Core\Response\Stream` is still in
`CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`, and `Core\Response\Stream::write` owes every proof. Nothing is blocked.

`nvs run --request` prints the response body alone, never the status line or the headers, so an
example about a status or a header shows it through the body it writes. A body member's bench
writes bodies with no newline in them, because a newline flushes the terminal on every call. The
wall-clock of these benches is noisy: compare the allocation and byte counts.
